correctness.rationale: For all finite irreducible birth–death generators, Jacobi similarity gives distinct real eigenvalues, and the strictly monotone rational multiplier preserves distinctness. With positive spectrum, the real log is unique; with a nonpositive simple eigenvalue, no real log exists. For \(\theta\le\frac12\), convergent log coefficients have the opposite parity sign to the tridiagonal length-two power entries, giving a strictly negative effective rate. For \(\theta>\frac12\), the first positive coefficient at each graph distance proves strict positive offdiagonal logarithmic rates for sufficiently small h. For \(\theta\ge1\) the exact integral of stochastic-resolvent generators gives unconditional strictly positive rates. The \(n=2\) exception and positive \(3\times3\) witness are algebraically complete. Self-contained exact-rational code verified 336 finite identities, but finite checks are not relied on to prove any infinite assertion.

evidence: Nonnegativity/total nonnegativity/stochastic-order preservation studied in finite-step literature are matrix-entry and cone properties. An embeddable Markov matrix is entrywise stochastic but the converse is false, as exhibited by the explicit strictly positive 3-state Crank–Nicolson matrix.
The sparse forward-Euler case is already ruled out by the transitivity obstruction of Baake et al. (2025), Example 3.4; we do not count it as a new independent result.
A general log-matrix test does not determine the sign for all paths, every rate and every step; the strict sign-coherent series and positive-resolvent integral are the new implication steps.

Earlier published overimplicit theta-method sign-variation results concern total nonnegativity, which is *not* required for homogeneous Markov embeddability; θ>1 can be embeddable while failing total nonnegativity.

Two exact-claim and equivalence searches in the published mathematical records returned the same [2/2] Padé positivity and filtered Crank–Nicolson kernel results as closest relevant statements; no publication returned an implication covering the homogeneous theta-method embedding theorem.

Zappavigna et al. and the nearest published numerical positivity/variation results do not imply homogeneous embeddability. value.rationale: This is a motivated exact structural classification of when rational time-stepping matrices admit a time-homogeneous continuous-time Markov interpretation. It separates positivity, spectral stability and embeddability at a sharp numerical-method parameter 1/2, establishes a three-state minimal obstruction with strictly positive stochastic entries, and finds unconditional embedding for \(\theta\ge1\). The path-sign lemma and positive-resolvent integral are valid for arbitrary positive adjacent rates and dimensions and are not an arbitrary finite-table recomputation.
